# Legacy observations: T6 Position shifter and all-tags tool (local probe, 2026-10-06)

Captured by the `legacy_visual_t6_capture` probe ([`visual_t6_capture.cpp`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/visual_t6_capture.cpp), target in [`tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt)) on the cases in [`inputs/visual-t6-cases.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/inputs/visual-t6-cases.txt). The probe compiles the legacy `HikariSub/VisualMoveAll.cpp`, `VisualAllTags.cpp`, `VisualAllTagsControls.cpp` and `Timebase.cpp` at `20d647c4` unchanged and copies these out of their files unchanged ([`extract_functions.py`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/extract_functions.py)): the `Visuals`, `moveElems`, `MoveAll` and `AllTags` classes (Visuals.h), `TagType`, `TagPasteMode` and `AllTagsSetting` (VisualAllTagsEdition.h), `FindData` and `TagFindReplace` (TagFindReplace.h), `ClipPoint` (VisualClipPoint.h), `AssColor` and `Styles` (styles.h), `TagData` and `ParseData` (SubsDialogue.h); `LoadSettings`, `GetNames` and `SaveSettings` (VisualAllTagsEdition.cpp); Visuals' constructor, destructor, GetDialoguesWithoutPosition, GetDialogueAdditionalPosition, GetRectFromSize, IsInRect, RenderSubs, both SetVisual, SizeChanged, DrawCross, DrawRect, DrawCircle, Draw, DrawWarning, CalcMovePos, GetVectorPoints, GetMoveTimes, GetPosnScale, GetPosition, SetModified, RotateDrawing, CalcDrawingSize, GetTextSize, GetDrawingSize and Curve; TagFindReplace's FindTag, ReplaceAll, ReplaceAllByChar, Replace, TagValueFromStyle, ReplaceValue, TagValueToStyle, GetDouble, GetTwoValueDouble, ChangeText, GetTextResult, GetPositionInText and FindBrackets; AssColor's constructors, SetAss, SetAlphaString, GetAss and GetAlpha, Styles' constructor and number getters and Copy; TagData, ParseData, Dialogue::ClearParse, ParseTags and GetDefaultPosition; ClipPoint's constructors; CreateVERTEX; getfloat and FindFromEnd.

They run against stand-ins ([`tools/legacy-capture/visual_t6/`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/visual_t6)) with the legacy member names: the Dialogue (Text, TextTl, Style, times, margins, isVisible), the grid and its file (the selection and SubsFile::GetSelections, which leaves out the Lines the Grid hides; SetModified, which records the step, takes the Line into the editor again and, unless dummy, sets the tool again as ShowEditOnVideo does), the editors (EditBox::GetEditor and IsCursorOnStart, Send writing the editors into the Line), the video (Tell, the Timebase, GetState, the toolbar's SetItemToggled), the Line editor's two "Insert difference" hotkeys at their defaults (Ctrl-, and Ctrl-.), wxBell (logged as "bell"), OpenWrite over files kept in memory (a BOM written first, wxConvAuto dropping it on reading) and the fixed text measure of the T3 probe. The Direct3D drawing is recorded: the probe's `d3d9.h` and `d3dx9.h` are the legacy tree's Linux stand-ins with `DrawPrimitiveUP` and `ID3DXLine::Draw` recording their vertices and colours, and `DRAWOUTTEXT` records its text, rectangle, alignment and colour (legacy drew it nine times for the outline).

Built locally with GCC 16.2.1 and the distribution's wxWidgets 3.2.11 (wxGTK). Run:

```
cmake -S tools/legacy-capture -B <dir> -DLEGACY_SOURCE=<checkout at 20d647c4> -DWX_CONFIG=$(which wx-config)
cmake --build <dir> --target legacy_visual_t6_capture
<dir>/legacy_visual_t6_capture < tools/legacy-capture/inputs/visual-t6-cases.txt > observations.jsonl
```

wxWidgets asserts on stderr that `AllTags::SetCurVisual`'s `wxString::Format(L"5.%if", digitsAfterDot)` passes an unsigned char for `%i`; the text it makes is the expected "5.1f" (a release build has no assertion). `observations.jsonl` holds one line per `state` step (150, over 35 cases, byte-identical over two runs): every Line's Text and TextTl, the editor's text and selection, the grid's SetModified and EditBox::Send records (with " same" when no Line's text changed), the log, the files, the definitions (VideoToolbar::tags), the toolbar's SetItemToggled calls, the tools' coefficients, from, to and moveValues, and per tool: MoveAll's elements (type, point, the clip's or drawing's points), numElem, selectedTags, beforeMove, drawingPos, drawingOriginalPos, drawingScale, scale and the vector scales; AllTags' actualTag, currentTag, mode, tagMode, multiplyCounter, the sliders' position, right holding, selectedTag, float format and the four sliders (values, rectangle, pointer, thumb state, hover, holding); and after a `draw` everything drawn. sha256 `c2ff06ff…0fb492`.

The cases (one 640x360 view with the coefficient 3 unless named): the Position shifter's position drag, every element at once (\org twice, a vector clip, a \move with times, an \iclip rectangle, a drawing left out while positions are on), \move start and end points one at a time and together, clips (a scaled vector clip with Bézier and B-spline parts, a vector and a rectangle clip in two blocks, a rectangle then a vector clip in one block), drawings (\an7, \an5 with \fscx, \p2, \org and \frz, \an3 with \move), a drawing with the position toggled too and the toolbar changed, a batch of five with a hidden Line, a Line outside the video's time and one without a position, Shift's axis lock, the right and middle buttons, the A/D/W/S keys with Shift, Alt, Ctrl and Alt+Ctrl, a click without a move on spaced and fractional numbers, Lines without elements and with malformed tags, TLMode, a zoomed view and a pillarbox; the definitions' defaults, a file with odd lines (a value that does not read, missing fields, blanks around fields, a fourth extra value), an old file without the version (replaced by the defaults), a file with a BOM, and SaveSettings' numbers; the all-tags tool's thumb drag and hover in Add, a track click, Insert at the caret and at the start, every change option on one Line (Multiply, Multiply+, the four gradients), the text gradients over \h, \N and spaces, every option over a batch with a hidden Line, TLMode, colours, alphas, \pos and \fad, \t with a selected tag, a value past the definition's range, the wheel with and without Shift (and on a colour), the sliders dragged with the right button and the pointer leaving, and the \fad and \t hotkeys (outside the Line and without a video: the bell).

## Compared with the rewrite

`VisualCapture.ReplaysTheLegacyT6Probe` (`hikari_application_visual_shift_tests`) builds each case's Document, view (from the frame and zoom, checked against the case's rectangle and zoom), selection, hidden Lines and caret, drives `visual::PositionShifterTool` and `visual::AllTagsTool` with the same pointer, wheel and key events, and at every step compares every Line's text and translation, the editor's text and caret on the one-Line path, the commits against the history steps the tools make, the log, the definitions and their file, the tools' state exactly and, after a `draw`, the overlay against the recorded drawing (every line's ends and colour, every rectangle's corners, fill and border, the circles, and each text's string, colour and place in its rectangle). Two differences are made by the rewrite and named in the report: a commit that changes no Line records no history step (legacy's CopyDialogue and Send made one: the " same" records are left out of the comparison), and MoveAll's `moveValues`, which legacy never initialised, are compared only where they were read.

The capture also shows four legacy defects that the rewrite no longer keeps: the user approved fixing them on 2026-10-06 as named departures ([compatibility-decisions.md](../../../../docs/qt/compatibility-decisions.md)). The capture stays as legacy's record; the replay's `departureFor` lists the states that expect the departure instead, and checks each changed value against legacy's to differ:

- T6-gradient-hard-space: the text gradients put a tag between "\" and "h" when a \h follows a block, as a gradient run again over a Line that starts with \h does (`{\blur12.1}\{\blur9.1}h…`, tags-gradient-text step 2). The replay expects `{\blur12.1}\hA{\blur9.6}b …` there.
- T6-clip-scale-carry: MoveAll kept a vector clip's scale from the last Line that had one (`vectorClipScale` was set only when a scale is read). No case reads two such Lines in turn, so no state changes.
- T6-drag-offset: a drag kept a whole-pixel offset between the pointer and the held handle (`diffs` is a wxPoint): the handle jumped by the fraction at the first move. The replay expects the Lines moved by the pointer's distance in shift-clips steps 1-2, shift-drawing 4-6, shift-nothing 3, shift-tlmode 1 and shift-zoomed 1-3, where the shifter's handles follow the drag and are not compared.
- T6-wheel-one-step: every slider took the wheel and wrote its value as its own step (tags-wheel-colour: three steps). The replay expects one commit there, with legacy's text.
